scope: Cargar orden now records a standalone inventory entry rather than a supplier purchase
changes: Remove supplier, reference, invoice and document date requirements
Select existing active products by name, SKU or barcode, including zero stock
Show received quantity, editable unit cost, retail price and optional wholesale price
Add Cargar nuevo producto with name, text SKU, optional text barcode and unit
Keep new products entirely in the draft until the entry is confirmed
Create new products, update edited prices and increment stock in one database transaction
Do not create purchase orders, purchase receipts, suppliers, expenses or financial movements
Preserve the pre-existing create, send and receive supplier purchase workflow

database.security: SECURITY INVOKER, active organization membership, existing product and inventory RLS, authenticated execution only
database.idempotency: Request UUID, transaction advisory lock and immutable payload/movement ledger
database.newProductConcurrency: Serialize new-product batches per organization before checking SKU and barcode collisions
database.stockWrites: Reuse public.adjust_inventory; never replace current stock directly
database.newProductDefaults: Active, zero stock before movement, no supplier, standard product defaults, not automatically published in the storefront
database.priceConflicts: HTTP 409, transaction rollback and explicit current-price reload without losing new product drafts
database.legacyPurchaseHistory: Existing orders, receipts and their original RPC remain unchanged
database.catalogCacheWarning: CLI migration catalog caching timed out after successful application; history, function privileges, anonymous API denial and data integrity were checked independently

verification.deviceTesting: Desktop Chrome and responsive emulation, not physical devices
checks: Owner and staff save mixed existing/new entries without supplier inputs
New products do not exist before confirmation and appear in inventory afterward
Argentine decimal quantities and prices persist correctly
Zero-prefixed identifiers remain text; duplicate and scientific identifiers are rejected
A late failure rolls back new products, price edits and stock movements together
Simultaneous retries create each new product and stock ingress once
Simultaneous independent entries reject cross-field SKU/barcode duplicates
Sales and storefront display the updated prices of existing published products
No horizontal overflow or serious/critical accessibility violations in tested views
